steps.name: Install reviewed exact CI driver versions
steps.run: node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync} from "node:fs"; import {execFileSync} from "node:child_process"; import {selectVersions} from "./bench/p0/versions.mjs"; const catalog=JSON.parse(readFileSync("bench/drivers.json","utf8")); const versions=selectVersions(catalog,process.env.PUPPETEER_VERSION ? {puppeteer:process.env.PUPPETEER_VERSION} : {}); execFileSync("npm",["install","--save-dev","--package-lock=false","--no-audit","--no-fund",...Object.entries(versions).map(([name,version])=>name+"@"+version)],{stdio:"inherit"});'
